name: srs
description: A tiny spaced-repetition stack shared by a web app and your agent.

interface.shortDescription: Learn anything with one simple stack of cards.
interface.longDescription: Create, edit, search, review, and schedule cards from chat or the minimal web app. FSRS handles the intervals and tags keep the stack coherent.
defaultPrompt: Turn this into cards I can remember.
Review my due cards with me.
